description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Collective Agreements No. 21 of 2015 entered into between Sri Lankan Airlines Limited and the Sri Lanka Nidahas Sevaka Sangamaya, No. 25 of 2015 entered into between Standard Chartered Bank and the Ceylon Bank Employees'Union and No. 29 of 2015 entered into between Bank of Ceylon and the Ceylon Bank Employees' Union
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between SriLankan Airlines and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, salaries, allowances, dispute resolution procedures, and other labor regulations. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves the formal publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes regulatory frameworks for employment conditions.
